job_registers.base: 0xA000_0150 (inside existing nn_mmio_sel = ext_addr[31:8]==0xA00001; current regs end at DBG2=0xA000_0148)

registers.name: NN_ID
registers.desc: signature + version v1

registers.name: NN_STATUS
registers.desc: bit0 busy, bit1 done(sticky, ack-clears), bit2 err, bit3 irq, bit4 job_pending, bit5 model_ready, bit6 npu_rst, bit7 timeout; [15:8] err_code; [31:16] npu_state

registers.name: NN_FRAME_NO
registers.desc: frame number of last completed job (latched with done)

registers.name: NN_CYCLES
registers.desc: NPU-domain cycles of last job (YOLO reference 1,191,020)

registers.name: NN_JOB_IN
registers.desc: input arena byte address; bit31=0 DDR offset (M4), bit31=1 on-chip A offset (legacy)

registers.name: NN_JOB_OUT
registers.desc: output arena byte address (same bit31 convention)

registers.name: NN_JOB_MODEL
registers.desc: [7:0] model_id (0 YOLO-C128, 1 Bottlecap-224, 2 Slim-160, 3 YOLO-C320); [15:8] ROM table start idx; bit16 irq_en; bit17 debug_csum; bit18 onchip_io; bit19 auto_start

registers.name: NN_JOB_FRAME
registers.desc: frame number echoed back on completion

registers.name: NN_DOORBELL
registers.desc: write 1 submit; read 1 = pending/running, 0 = idle; write while busy -> dropped + NN_DROP_CNT++

registers.name: NN_ACK
registers.desc: write 1 clears done/err/irq and releases the result mailbox (pango acknowledge)

registers.name: NN_DROP_CNT
registers.desc: dropped doorbells/frames counter

registers.name: NN_TIMEOUT
registers.desc: job watchdog threshold in NPU cycles (100M ~= 1s @100MHz); 0 disables

registers.name: NN_ERR_CODE
registers.desc: sticky error code; [7:0] code, [15:8] failing op index

registers.name: NN_CTRL2
registers.desc: bit0 npu_reset(W1P), bit1 irq_en, bit2 debug_mode (per-op csum), bit3 pending_en (1-deep queue); [15:8] drop_policy (0 drop-new, 1 overwrite-oldest)

registers.name: NN_JOBS_DONE
registers.desc: completed jobs counter (cpu domain)

registers.name: NN_NPU_STATE
registers.desc: npU debug: {seq_state[3:0], op_idx[7:0], pre_busy, tile_busy}

registers.name: NN_FRAME_IN
registers.desc: input frame slot base (DDR offset or on-chip A)

registers.name: NN_FRAME_STATUS
registers.desc: bit0 frame_ready, bit1 frame_lost; [15:8] slot; [31:16] latest frame_no low16

registers.name: NN_RESULT_PTR
registers.desc: current result slot {slot[1:0], addr[29:0]}

registers.name: NN_RESULT_CSUM
registers.desc: result header FNV-1a (anti-tear / reconciliation)

result_mailbox.implementation: true dual-port BRAM (1 tile): write port npu_clk (nn_subsys on job completion), read port cpu_clk mapped into the existing nn_* data window (1-cycle registered read, core unchanged)

cpu_window.offset: 0x00000..0x007FF = mailbox in decoupled mode; 0x00800+ = legacy A/B (kept only in single-clock legacy build)

layout.field: reserved (scalar/small results; big tensors live in DDR output arena)

result_mailbox.anti_tear: header (magic+frame_no) written last; consumer checks magic+frame_no+csum; NPU does not start the next job before ACK (pango start && !done semantics)

ddr_map.assumption: 2 DDR3 chips on board (user-confirmed, interfaces TBD); 32-bit total width assumed; MIG not yet integrated (zero evidence in repo)

regions.use: weight image (2,020,960 B, op-order contiguous, 16B aligned)
output/result arena: 3 slots x 32KB (triple buffering; YOLO 20.4KB, bottlecap 28.2KB per frame)
input frame double buffer (2 x 128KB; 224-packed 150,528B/frame needs 2x160KB -> may live in the 16MB video region instead)
reserved (model table / persistent mailbox / DDR self-test image / future batch)

decoupled_recommendation.W: 2 banks x 128KiB = 64 tiles (max layer 124,416 B; nn_wload already caps prefetch at 128KiB) -> frees 16 tiles
decoupled_recommendation.A_B: reused as M4 IBUF/OBUF tile cache (IBUF 2x16KB + OBUF 2x12KB = 56KB = 12.4 tiles)
decoupled_recommendation.ROM: 128 x 256 bit = 1-2 tiles (256 deep if runtime model switching is required)
decoupled_recommendation.budget_after: W64 + Q8 + A/B32 + ROM2 + mailbox1 + job LUTRAM ~= 107 tiles -> ~28 free (tile cache 12.4 + headroom)

cpu_window_policy.legacy_single_clock_build: keep A/B mapping unchanged (C128 YOLO E2E, tb_nn_mem, tb_sw_nn_yolo depend on it); busy -> 0xDEADBEEF
cpu_window_policy.decoupled_build: disable CPU A/B access (read 0, write ignored + err); map window offset 0x00000..0x007FF to the 2KB result mailbox; CPU never touches A/B (pango-style private NPU RAM)
cpu_window_policy.why_no_A_B_cdc: a 512KB CPU data window crossing two clocks would need a full window bridge (read latency + CDC); decoupling removes the need entirely; the only result path is the 2KB TDP mailbox

input.placement: DDR input arena (or on-chip A for slim/legacy)
input.commit: producer writes last byte -> frame_commit pulse + frame_no + slot -> NN_FRAME_STATUS.frame_ready
input.drop_policy: if NPU busy OR done-not-acked -> drop new frame (DROP_CNT++, frame_lost=1); never overwrite the buffer in use; do not pause the producer (pango: camera/LCD never pause)

output.consume: CPU/display reads only a done + unacked slot; ACK releases it; 3rd slot + flow control prevents overwrite
output.anti_tear: magic+frame_no+csum match; display commits at frame boundary (pango vision_soc.v:269-280)
